course: 1C:Enterprise 8 Programming — from foundations to professional development
title: Tariff history: key, period and last slice
goal: Write two own tariff facts and verify before, at and before the first boundary.

prerequisites.text: onec.p5; P1–P3; explicit contracts, types, collections and failure handling.

sections.title: Facts by key
paragraphs: An information register suits rates by service and time. Service is a dimension, rate a resource, and period adds history. An attribute stores extra description rather than replacing the key. Start from “which rate applied toS1 atD”; one current card price cannot answer the historical question.

Create independent day-periodic information register ТарифыУслуг: Услуга: CatalogRef.Услуги dimension and Тариф: Number(15,2) resource. Период is its platform period field, not a second custom date. The card’s ТарифЗаЧас is distinct and unchanged; this exercise implements no automatic costing.

sections.title: Periodicity limits distinguishable states
paragraphs: Two records for one service in one period follow the key policy. Daily periodicity cannot distinguish two intraday changes under the same key. Do not substitute current time just to bypass a collision. Choose required precision and test exactly at a rate-change boundary.

The function creates an own service and facts November 1=100 and 15=150. СрезПоследних filtered by its reference returns 100 on 14 and 150 on 15. It selects current state per key rather than summing 250, without including other services.

sections.title: A slice is not a sum of prices
paragraphs: Between changes, use the latest applicable rate rather than summing history. SliceLast represents state at a time; record sets represent history. Explicitly return absence or reject when no prior rate exists. Automatic zero can resemble a free service and hide missing data.

Before the first fact there are no rows. Missing and zero tariffs differ and need an explicit calculation policy. Day periodicity does not distinguish two changes inside the same day/key; a different requirement needs different periodicity/key design.

sections.title: Discriminating semantic control
paragraphs: A compilable wrong value is not a syntax-only test.

sections.title: Test history at boundary dates
paragraphs: Set rate 100 fromD1 and 150 fromD2. Expect absence beforeD1, 100 betweenD1/D2, and 150 at the agreed inclusiveD2 boundary. Reopen and verify. Repeating the same keys must not increase count; editing copy rates must preserve the source.

A compilable 151 mutation fails the independent 150 boundary expectation. This uses an actual register, not a browser array. Each run creates a new own service; retain the function/protocol and remove the startup call.

sections.title: Check your explanation
paragraphs: A helper definition is duplicated inside the startup handler. Keep one module-level helper and only its call inside startup.
Whole-register totals replace the own-key control. Filter by the actual customer/service/recorder reference for this experiment.
A runnable result is treated as proof of all accounting/security behavior. Record each checked mechanism and retain untested concurrency/edition limits.
